newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares seen flat to firmer,helped by bonds.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares seen flat to firmer,helped by bonds.

text.p: 0740 GMT - Belgian shares seen helped by firm bonds, dollar, shrugging off lacklustre overnight performance on Wall Street .DJI. Focus on May U.S. CPI due 1230 GMT, seen little changed
* Pre-bourse trade puts Solvay up slightly at 22,700 francs, Bekaert up slightly at 21,600 francs, but GBL, one of Monday's few gainers, down at 5,960 francs.
